title: Obsidian parity-first sync

portable_to: Hermes Agent cron in no-agent mode
Windows Task Scheduler after adapting local paths

inputs: two or more independently authored vault trees

risk.confirmation: must remain paused until read-only manifests and immutable backups are verified

verification: filename/size/hash manifests collected from every tree
merge is additive before any deletion
only one live sync transport owns a tree
secrets_policy: vault contents and paths never enter public logs
limitations: This job is paused because two independently edited trees have not been reconciled yet.
A sync tool is not a merge proof; enabling this blindly can propagate deletions or overwrite unique notes.
The actual vault paths, backup destinations, and private note contents are not included.
